newsitem.title: CANADA: DBRS confirms Brookfield Homes ratings.
newsitem.headline: DBRS confirms Brookfield Homes ratings.

text.p: Dominion Bond Rating Service on Tuesday said it confirmed the ratings of Brookfield Homes' senior debt at BB, with a stable trend.

The bond rating agency said because all the old senior secured debentures have been retired, it is assigning the notional rating to debt which would fit into the level of debt vacated by the matured senior secured debentures.

DBRS said many of the company's basic problems remain, as the company has a large land/housing portfolio and has too much debt for the cash flow that it generates. Despite this a recovery is underway, as the company is recovering capital invested in its land portfolio by an orderly net sale of the portfolio, the agency said.
DBRS said a net recovery of C$500 million in cash is projected by the year 2000, and the company has the continuing support of the The Edper Group.
